intro: Magram Village is the settlement of the Magram centaur clan, situated among foul yellow pools in southeastern Desolace. It serves as the primary base for the Magram as they wage relentless war against their hated rivals, the Gelkis.

p: Sprawled across islands and shores around stagnant, sulfurous pools in southeast Desolace, Magram Village is a rugged settlement cobbled together with crude wooden bridges and hide tents. The Magram centaur dwell here in constant vigilance against neighboring clans. Known for their sheer brutality and deep-seated animosity toward the southern Gelkis clan, the Magram are willing to tolerate outsiders only if those travelers prove their worth by slaughtering their Gelkis enemies.
